title: Fix Duplicate Package Declaration Breaking Compose Go Build
description: compose/client/lib/go/main.go has a duplicate `package compose` declaration and a duplicate `import ( "encoding/json" "fmt" )` block around line 17733, right after the `// #endregion 📡SQLite` / `// #region kit_graph` markers. This breaks `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` for the whole @semio-tech/compose-go package with syntax errors. Remove the duplicate package/import block and ensure encoding/json and fmt are present in the single top-of-file import block (check for existing duplicates before adding). Verify with `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...`. This was already identified and documented (but not fixed, as out of scope) in the report-semio-tech-compose-go.md file from the Overhaul Test Suites ticket.
summary: Removed the duplicate `package compose` declaration and duplicate `import ("encoding/json"; "fmt")` block that had been left mid-file (~line 17733, right after the `#endregion 📡SQLite` / `#region kit_graph` markers) from a botched region merge. Both `encoding/json` and `fmt` were already present in the single top-of-file import block, so no import additions were needed — just deletion of the duplicate header. Verified `go build ./...` now succeeds (previously failed with "non-declaration statement outside function body" / "imports must appear before other declarations") and `go vet ./...` runs cleanly aside from pre-existing, unrelated sync.Mutex-by-value warnings scattered throughout the file. `go test ./...` now compiles and executes (previously couldn't compile at all) but most tests fail on missing fixture files at stale relative paths (../asset/compose/*.json, ../sqlite/schema.sql, ../postgres/schema.sql) — this is a separate pre-existing issue, out of scope for this ticket, flagged as a follow-up task.
